第482章 黑历史还是黑历史（第1页）
“你们不是前一阵大周仙朝刚见过吗？！”玄微真人怒。
几日不见，这老头青天白日说胡话的本事真是越来越精深了。
“哦吼吼吼吼吼。”姜家主乐呵呵的灌着酒葫芦里的酒。
两位相交万古的老友法驾并行于云海之上，微笑互怼。
下方修士仰头看着二人风姿，满眼敬畏，不知情的以为在谈论什么高层次话题。
于是难免又是一阵感慨：“这两位可是真正的世外老神仙啊。”
结果话音刚落，云海另一头忽然传来一声嗤笑，陡然横插而来，响彻整片空域：
“当年姜守拙被云渊灌醉，抱着太上道宗山门口的石碑哭着喊师叔祖的时候，可像个什么老神仙？”
谁这么敢说？当众揭姜氏家主的陈年黑历史？
还有，你个大佬居然偷听我们说话，你闲不闲啊，有病吧？！
众人面面相觑，心底暗自腹诽，身体却很一致的齐齐抬头。
只见一架巨型风轮法宝自西南而来。
其上一名身材壮硕的中年男子单足踏于其上，他衣袍华贵，负手而立，倒是一副极潇洒的模样。
姜守拙看见他，脸上的笑意顿时淡了些。
他一脸晦气，干脆直接转头将车帘一拉，眼不见心不烦，装作完全没有看见此人。
玄微真人倒是淡淡望了中年男子一眼。
“贫道还记得你当初出言冒犯青莲剑宗诸位女修，被剑宗伤门、惊门、离门三位女剑尊追杀整整八万里，一路丢盔弃甲、狼狈逃窜。”

“这么多年过去，都是一把年纪的人了，你这一张嘴，依旧半点不曾收敛。”
剑光之前，莲影次第绽放。青莲剑宗副宗主，青霄剑尊陆青霄，踏剑而至。
他剑眉星目，身姿笔挺，刚到云梦泽上空，便听见玄微真人那句话。
陆青霄闻声眸光一凛，侧眸精准锁定风湖，同时右手五指收拢，已然稳稳搭在腰间佩剑的剑柄之上，剑压丝丝缕缕弥散而开。
姜守拙低头喝酒，玄微真人拂尘轻垂。
哥俩默契的像没看见陆青霄按剑一样。
但是下方众人看见了啊，大家都是仙界修士，眼力能差到哪去？
当年风湖之事，下面的老一辈修士其实都隐隐知道些。
风氏右长老风湖，年轻时便是个极端倨傲之人。如果用云擎前世的话说，呃…就是个修仙界出了名的“极端大男子主义者”。
他自负风氏嫡系血脉，固执的认定诸天万界乃是男子的天下，女修即便天资不错，也更该在后方安稳孕育子嗣、相夫教子，为家族延绵血脉。

Chapter 482 Black History or Black History (Page 1)
"Didn't you just meet the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty a while ago?!" Master Xuanwei was angry.
I haven't seen him for a few days, and this old man's ability to talk nonsense has really become more and more sophisticated.
"Oh ho ho ho ho ho." The head of the Jiang family happily drank the wine from the wine gourd.
Two old friends who have known each other for eternity, Fajia, walked side by side above the sea of ​​clouds, smiling at each other.
The monk below looked up at the graceful appearance of the two men, his eyes full of awe, and he thought they were talking about some high-level topic.
So it was inevitable that there would be another sigh: "These two are truly otherworldly old gods."
As soon as he finished speaking, a sneer suddenly came from the other side of the sea of clouds, suddenly coming across and resounding throughout the entire airspace:
"Back then, when Jiang Shouzhuo was drunk by Yun Yuan, hugging the stone tablet at the gate of Taishang Daozong Mountain and crying and calling his uncle, did he look like an old god?"
Who dares to say that? Revealing the dark history of the Jiang family head in public?
Also, you boss actually eavesdropped on our conversation. Are you busy? Are you sick? !
Everyone looked at each other and cursed secretly in their hearts, but their bodies raised their heads in unison.
I saw a giant wind wheel magic weapon coming from the southwest.
A sturdy middle-aged man stood on it with one foot. He was dressed in luxurious robes and stood with his hands behind his back. He looked very chic.
When Jiang Shouzhuo saw him, the smile on his face suddenly faded.
He looked unhappy, so he simply turned around and pulled the car curtain, out of sight and out of mind, pretending not to see the person at all.
Master Xuanwei glanced at the middle-aged man indifferently.
"Pindao still remembers that when you insulted the female cultivators of the Qinglian Sword Sect, you were chased for eighty thousand miles by the three female sword masters of the Sword Sect: Shangmen, Jingmen, and Limen. You abandoned your armor and fled in embarrassment along the way."
"After all these years, you are already a very old man, but you still haven't restrained your mouth at all."
Before the sword light, the lotus shadow bloomed one after another. Lu Qingxiao, the deputy master of the Qinglian Sword Sect and the Qingxiao Sword Master, arrived with his sword in hand.
He had sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, and a straight posture. As soon as he reached the sky above Yunmengze, he heard the words of Master Xuanwei.
Lu Qingxiao's eyes froze when he heard the sound, and his side eyes were precisely focused on Fenghu. At the same time, he gathered the five fingers of his right hand and placed them firmly on the hilt of the sword at his waist. The sword spread out in wisps.
Jiang Shouzhuo lowered his head to drink, while Master Xuanwei hung his whisk lightly.
The two brothers had a tacit understanding, as if they hadn't seen Lu Qingxiao touch his sword.
But everyone below saw it. We are all monks in the immortal world. How can our eyesight be so bad?
In fact, the older generation of monks below were vaguely aware of what happened at Fenghu.
Feng Hu, the right elder of the Feng clan, was an extremely arrogant person when he was young. If Yun Qing used the words of his previous life, well... he was a well-known "extreme male chauvinist" in the world of immortality.
He prides himself on his direct lineage from the Feng family, and stubbornly believes that the world belongs to men. Even if female cultivators are talented, they should be able to safely give birth to children at home, support their husbands and educate their children, and extend the bloodline of the family.
